title: Build a Responsive Product Card Grid
description: Create a responsive card layout using CSS Grid that automatically adjusts columns based on screen width
objective: Students will build a responsive product card grid using CSS Grid's auto-fit, create hover effects, and verify responsiveness across screen sizes using Chrome DevTools

steps.title: Set Up the Project
steps.instructions:
Create a new folder called `card-grid`. Create two files: - `index.html` - `style.css` Open the folder in VS Code. Install the **Live Server** extension if you haven't already. In `index.html`, set up the basic structure: ```html Course Cards

Our Courses

``` Right-click `index.html` → **Open with Live Server**.

steps.title: Create the Card HTML
steps.instructions:
Inside the `.card-grid` div, add 6 course cards: ```html
ADCA
12 Months

Advanced Diploma in Computer Applications

Master Python, Web Dev, AI Tools, and get placement support.

₹35,000 Enroll Now
``` Duplicate this card 5 more times with different courses: - DCA (6 Months, ₹18,000, color #34d399) - Tally Pro (3 Months, ₹8,000, color #fbbf24) - Python Mastery (4 Months, ₹12,000, color #3b82f6) - Web Development (6 Months, ₹20,000, color #f472b6) - AI & Data Science (6 Months, ₹25,000, color #a78bfa) Change the background color on each `.card-image` div.

steps.title: Style with CSS Grid
Style the Cards
Test Responsiveness

starter_code: Our Courses
expected_output: A responsive card grid that shows 3 columns on desktop, 2 on tablet, and 1 on mobile — with hover effects, consistent styling, and no media queries for the grid layout
